baseline: Unchanged release paragraph-reading collector over frozen originals
arm_order: Use the unchanged original rubric arm_order
primary_measures: Frozen exact-source material checks banked at the common physical ceiling
Actual model HTTP attempts, known tokens and unknown usage
Plan failures and bounded closure, with actual request content audit
Version-valid pinned review delivery, excerpts and material assessments
Complete versus censored versus transport-failed dispatch states
review_rules: Compare V2 with the fresh baseline and prior V1; report baseline sampling variability
Transport failures and missing arms are not zero-quality outcomes
Banked counts alone do not establish relevance, adequacy or downstream visibility
Inspect each selected body for target entity, date, metric, complete rows and context
Report measured retention separately from the unchanged release analysis projection
No automatic restart, model switch, budget increase, worker duplication or production promotion
next_gate: Only consider an untouched small pilot if V2 improves useful material retention over the concurrent baseline without integrity regressions or a material cost increase. This repaired five-case cohort cannot validate generalization.
temporal_scope: Retrospective current captures; not a cutoff-safe forecasting evaluation
